decisions.reason: As a close-to-core cutting and creasing finisher that has remained in the portfolio since 2023, we would keep it because continued investment and fit with our established finishing range make any modest sales weakness still look temporary rather than decisive.

We would keep this sheet preparation module because it directly supports our modular automation strategy and another year on the market increases our commitment to justify the launch rather than reverse it.
We would keep this B2-format multifinisher because it is both close to our core business and publicly positioned as a strategic flagship, so the firm is especially committed to persisting with it.

We would keep the hybrid saddle stitcher because it extends our established booklet-making offer and, in a growing market, it is easy to attribute any disappointing traction to a longer adoption cycle instead of product failure.

We would keep the folding add-on unit because it complements existing equipment, has already been tied to a named customer application, and therefore carries both practical and reputational reasons to continue.
